items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s not two-track. I mean, that may not have been 24 track, but it was multi- track somehow. I don’t know what I had at the time. That was during the period working with Creed

ctx.x: I’m just saying…Okay, cause I thought a lot of that was direct to two track.
What about that Bill Evans recording?
